newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Ralston leaves TV3 for Metro editorship.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Ralston leaves TV3 for Metro editorship.

text.p: TV3 current affairs presenter Bill Ralston said on Thursday he was leaving the station to become editor of Auckland-based magazine Metro.
Ralston, a former TV3 political editor of TV3 who had been with the station since it was launched seven and a half years ago, said Metro would remain focussed on the Auckland market.

Asked about his plans for the magazine, Ralston said, "It is a matter of rebuilding its circulation because it has been in a drift for the last couple of years... (through) a heavy emphasis on journalism basically."
